cd /workspace && timeout 100 python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import compiler as C
links=[(1,2,0),(1,3,1),(0,1,3),(2,3,2),(0,2,2)]
linkuv=[(u,v) for u,v,c in links]; cap=[c for u,v,c in links]
parts=[0,2,3]; demand={0:0,2:3,3:0}
fab=C.Fabric(4,linkuv,cap,parts)
D=3
# try deterministic attempts with more modes/orders, then brute-force random attempts
import random
rng=random.Random(1)
ok=0
t0=time.time()
for i in range(200000):
    order=parts[:]; rng.shuffle(order)
    mode=rng.choice((0,1,2))
    frac=rng.choice((1.0,1.0,0.5,0.34,0.25,0.2))
    p=C._attempt(fab,parts,demand,D,order,mode,rng,frac)
    if p is not None and C.verify_plan(p,4,linkuv,cap,parts,demand):
        ok+=1
        if ok==1:
            print("FOUND at attempt",i,"mode",mode,"frac",frac,"order",order)
            print("trees",p['trees'])
            break
print("ok",ok,"time %.1fs"%(time.time()-t0))
PYEOF
